quotes next single word only that must be Lojbanic
quotes next single word only that can be not Lojbanic. The quoted word is delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespaces (in writing) from both sides. The quoted word can't have pauses inside if pronounced, nor dots when written

separates topic and comment
quotes a text that can be not Lojbanic. The quotation is to be wrapped with pauses from both sides and with an additional Lojbanic word around them from both sides. Usually the separating words is the name of the first letter of the language of the quotation
